SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders t WHERE
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%m-%d'), DATE(t.pay_time) ORDER BY DATE(t.pay_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders t WHERE
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT COALESCE(od.product_name, '未知产品') AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(od.amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders t INNER JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = t.id WHERE
GROUP BY od.product_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT t.create_by AS username, COALESCE(su.real_name, t.create_by_name, t.create_by) AS realName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.username = t.create_by AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE AND t.create_by IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.create_by, realName ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 20

GROUP BY od.order_detail_type

SELECT COALESCE(sl.source, 'UNKNOWN') AS source, COALESCE(sl.source, 'UNKNOWN') AS sourceLabel, COUNT(t.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS orderAmount FROM orders t LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN sale_lead sl ON sl.id = ci.lead_id AND sl.deleted = 0 WHERE
GROUP BY sl.source ORDER BY orderAmount DESC

SELECT t.create_by AS username, COALESCE(su.real_name, t.create_by_name, t.create_by) AS realName, COUNT(*) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS refundAmount FROM orders t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.username = t.create_by AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE AND t.create_by IS NOT NULL
